# Upscale.media

> > AI-powered image and video upscaling platform offering resolution enhancement, detail preservation, and photo quality improvement without Photoshop.

Upscale.media provides free and premium AI-driven tools for converting low-resolution images to high-resolution, enhancing photo quality, and upscaling videos to HD/4K. The platform serves photographers, digital artists, and businesses with API integration capabilities and credit-based subscription plans.

## Key Topics

- AI image upscaling
- Image resolution enhancement
- Detail preservation
- Photo quality improvement
- Video upscaling to 4K
- AI image enhancement
- API integration
- Credit-based pricing
- Photoshop alternatives
- JPEG optimization
- Batch processing
- Social media image optimization
- Digital art upscaling
- PixelBin.io integration

## Core AI Tools

- [Convert Low Resolution to High Resolution Online for Free (Images)](https://www.upscale.media/tools/low-resolution-to-high-resolution): Free AI-powered tool to convert low-res images to high-res instantly
- [AI Image Enhancement - Enhance Photo Quality With AI](https://www.upscale.media/tools/ai-image-enhancement): AI-powered image enhancement with upscaling and color correction
- [Free AI Video Upscaler (Turkish)](https://www.upscale.media/tr/video-upscale): Free AI video upscaler supporting HD, Full HD, and 4K (Turkish)
